title: Japan 40-Year JGB auction (¥300bn anticipated, second reopening of issue 19) — the only single-price auction on the JGB calendar, and the next read on super-long demand after 09-15
source: EST: mof.go.jp English September 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2609e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 25,556 bytes) for this initial research, whose table row reads 'Sep. 29, 2026 | 40-year'. The DATE is MOF's own. The SIZE is not yet announced and is anticipated, not sourced: that row's 'Auction Announcement' cell carries NO link on 2026-09-08, where the 09-15 20-year row already links its live announcement (announcement/auct20260908e.htm) — MOF's own calendar note states 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', so the confirming primary lands ~2026-09-18 to 09-22. The ¥300bn anticipated size and the reopening read come from a second MOF primary, the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, downloaded 2026-09-08 and parsed this session): the 40-year runs bi-monthly, issue 19 (3.8% coupon, maturity 2066-03-20) was first sold 2026-05-27 at ¥300bn and reopened 2026-07-22 at ¥300bn, making 09-29 the second reopening of issue 19 at the same size. MOF's October 2026 calendar (calendar/2610e.htm, HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes, fetched 2026-09-08) carries NO 40-year, independently confirming the bi-monthly cadence. Filed `estimate` on two counts: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office (the same limit jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15, boj-decision-2026-09-18 and ecb-decision-2026-09-10 all record). Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Proposed 2026-09-08 by the jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15 initial-research adjacency sweep (proposals/jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29.from-jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15.json, read as input and now shadowed by this canonical file); researched the same day (docs/research/events/jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29.md). The research corrected the premise it was proposed on. THE 40-YEAR IS A SINGLE-PRICE (DUTCH) AUCTION and is the only conventional JGB coupon tenor that is: across all eight 40-year result pages 2025-05-28 → 2026-07-22 MOF prints '-' in both 'Weighted Average Price' and 'Yield at the Average Price', where the 2026-08-20 20-year page prints 100.02 / 3.698% against a 99.85 / 3.713% low (a 1.5bp tail); of the 14 tenor sheets in MOF's own results workbook only the 40-year and the two GX green sheets lack an average-price column. So THE TAIL — the metric the 09-15 sibling ledger's whole framework and its FT-1 kill switch are built on — DOES NOT EXIST HERE and may not be transplanted. Its stand-in, computed this session over all 95 auctions since 2007-11-06: the clearing (highest accepted) yield minus MOF's same-session par 40-year, mean -0.25bp, sd 1.78bp, p95 +2.83bp, only 4 of 95 above +3bp. Two further measured findings. (1) THE 30s40s SPREAD HAS COLLAPSED to +0.4bp (2026-09-07), the 1.7th percentile of 4,606 sessions since 2007 — ten extra years of duration currently pay essentially nothing — and it was NEGATIVE (-6.0bp, -5.9bp) at each of the last two 40-year auctions, both of which covered 2.702x and 2.824x, the two best covers since 2025-03. (2) THE SEPTEMBER-IS-WEAK STORY IS AN ARTIFACT: raw September cover averages 2.757 vs 3.028 for other months (t = -2.43, n=10 vs 85), but comparing each September auction to its own two neighbouring auctions the deficit is -0.021 (t = -0.19) — the raw gap is regime clustering, not the Japanese H1 book-close. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` for the same reasons as the 09-15 entry, retested at this tenor: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, and the 40-year-auction-to-US-30Y spillover is a null whose SIGN DOES NOT EVEN HOLD across samples (full sample n=94: soft auctions precede -1.10bp vs firm +0.56bp, t = -1.45; 2023+ n=22: +1.43 vs +0.07, t = +1.08). It sits eleven days after boj-decision-2026-09-18, making it the first super-long JGB auction to price a post-decision policy rate, and one day before the Japanese fiscal half-year closes on 09-30. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
